title: Wire ForeshadowingManager lifecycle to MCP endpoints + UI
description: F2 Foreshadowing Lifecycle: Expose plant(), hint(), harvest(), getStats() methods from 662-line ForeshadowingManager via MCP endpoints. Create frontend API functions. Build foreshadowing lifecycle UI panel replacing minimal status filter in MemoryForm.tsx.
action: Create foreshadowing MCP endpoints (POST /foreshadow/plant, POST /foreshadow/hint, POST /foreshadow/harvest, GET /foreshadow/stats), add frontend API functions in knowledge.ts, build lifecycle UI panel in MemoryForm.tsx with PLANTED/HINTED/HARVESTED status columns

criteria: New foreshadow endpoint file exists in src-tauri/bin/sidecar/mcp/endpoints/
knowledge.ts exports plantForeshadow, hintForeshadow, harvestForeshadow functions
MemoryForm.tsx contains lifecycle management UI with PLANTED/HINTED/HARVESTED status display
convergence.verification: Call plant endpoint, verify response. Call hint with planted item id, verify status transition. Call harvest, verify completion. Check UI renders lifecycle stages.
convergence.definition_of_done: Foreshadowing lifecycle (plant→hint→harvest) exposed via API and consumable by UI

files.change: Create 4 endpoint handlers: plant (POST, params: content, chapter, metadata), hint (POST, params: id, hintContent), harvest (POST, params: id, harvestContent), stats (GET, returns lifecycle counts). Register in gateway.
Add plantForeshadow, hintForeshadow, harvestForeshadow, getForeshadowStats async functions calling new MCP endpoints.
Replace minimal status/chapter filter (lines 172-200) with lifecycle management panel showing PLANTED/HINTED/HARVESTED status columns with action buttons for state transitions.

implementation: Create src-tauri/bin/sidecar/mcp/endpoints/foreshadow.js: import ForeshadowingManager, create 4 endpoint handlers following graph.js pattern with jsonResponse/parseBody
In foreshadow.js plant handler: extract content/chapter/metadata from body, call foreshadowingManager.plant(), return planted item with id and status
In foreshadow.js hint handler: extract id + hintContent, call foreshadowingManager.hint(id, hintContent), return updated item
In foreshadow.js harvest handler: extract id + harvestContent, call foreshadowingManager.harvest(id, harvestContent), return completed item
In knowledge.ts: add 4 async functions with TypeScript types matching endpoint signatures
In MemoryForm.tsx: replace foreshadow filter section with lifecycle panel using existing UI patterns (columns for each status, cards for items, action buttons for transitions)

integration: Full lifecycle: plant → query → hint → query → harvest → verify complete

reference.pattern: MCP endpoint pattern from graph.js: jsonResponse/parseBody + async handlers
reference.examples: graph.js shows endpoint registration pattern; foreshadowing.js has plant/hint/harvest/getStats methods ready to call

rationale.chosen_approach: New endpoint file (foreshadow.js) rather than extending graph.js — foreshadowing is a distinct domain
decision_factors: Lifecycle (plant→hint→harvest) is distinct from generic graph queries
Key market differentiator warrants dedicated endpoint file
rationale.tradeoffs: New file vs extending graph.js — slightly more files but cleaner separation

risks.risk: ForeshadowingManager internal API may not match expected signatures
risks.mitigation: Read foreshadowing.js method signatures carefully before implementing endpoints
Start with simple status columns, iterate. No new UI libraries.
